title: 第9章 汉中对策
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

有人认为，如果韩信活在三国，诸葛亮或许只能当他的谋士。这不是狂言，而是历史的残酷逻辑。韩信仅用一场对话就让刘邦从“汉中王”蜕变为“汉高祖”，从此开启了大汉四百年基业。而四百年后，诸葛亮在隆中草庐为刘备勾勒《隆中对》却终成“出师未捷身先死”的悲歌。穷尽一生未能让刘备走出益州一步。

同样是“弱势逆袭”的剧本，为何韩信的“汉中对”能碾压诸葛亮的“隆中对”？这场跨越四百年的“战略对决”背后藏着弱者逆袭的终极密码。

拜将仪式结束后，刘邦第一时间把韩信拉入帐中，高职高薪都给了，下面该谈谈工作计划了。

韩信此刻的压力也不小，毕竟这是第一次面试，如果表现不好，估计下一秒就得走人了。

刘邦首先提问：“眼下队伍人心涣散，巴蜀离关中太远，大伙都想家，每天都有人走。你认为公司未来的出路在哪里？”

韩信反问：“主公要东征，要夺取天下，您自己估量一下，论兵力的英勇、强悍、精良，跟项羽比谁高谁下？”

刘邦沉默了一会儿说：“我恐怕不如项王。”

韩信说：“不仅主公自己，连我也觉得您不如项羽。我曾经在项羽帐下做过事，对他的为人还算了解，不妨让我来分析一下项羽这个人。”在韩信看来，项羽有哪些缺点呢？

首先匹夫之勇。项羽确实称得上是英雄，他喜欢身先士卒，亲临战阵，一声怒喝，千人会胆颤腿软。可是他不能放手任用贤将，只有将才，没有帅才，只能算是匹夫之勇。

其次妇人之仁。项羽平常待人恭敬慈爱，语言温和，士兵中如果有人生病了，项羽一准同情落泪，把自己的饭分给大伙。但有哪个人立了大功，该赐爵封侯时，项羽的小气就显现出来了，官印在手里把玩，玩到磨损了，还舍不得把官印给到应得之人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Some people think that if Han Xin lived in the Three Kingdoms, Zhuge Liang might only be his counselor.This is not wild talk, but the cruel logic of history.With just one conversation, Han Xin transformed Liu Bang from the "King of Hanzhong" to the "Gaozu of the Han Dynasty", thus starting the 400-year foundation of the Han Dynasty.Four hundred years later, Zhuge Liang sketched "Longzhong Dui" for Liu Bei in the Longzhong Thatched Cottage, but it ended up being a tragic song of "died before leaving the army".He spent his entire life unable to get Liu Bei out of Yizhou.

It is also a "weak counterattack" script, why can Han Xin's "Hanzhong pair" crush Zhuge Liang's "Longzhong pair"?Behind this "strategic showdown" spanning four hundred years lies the ultimate code for the weak to counterattack.

After the general worship ceremony, Liu Bang immediately recruited Han Xin into his account and gave him a high position and a high salary. Now it's time to talk about the work plan.

Han Xin was under a lot of pressure at the moment. After all, this was his first interview. If he didn't perform well, he would probably have to leave in the next second.

Liu Bang first asked: "Right now, the team is disengaged, Bashu is too far away from Guanzhong, everyone is homesick, and people leave every day. Where do you think the company's future will be?"

Han Xin asked back: "My lord wants to march eastward and seize the world. You can evaluate it yourself. In terms of bravery, strength, and sophistication of the troops, who is better than Xiang Yu?"

Liu Bang was silent for a while and said, "I'm afraid I'm not as good as King Xiang."

Han Xin said: "Not only my lord, but I also think that you are not as good as Xiang Yu. I have worked under Xiang Yu before, and I know him fairly well. Let me analyze Xiang Yu." In Han Xin's opinion, what are Xiang Yu's shortcomings?

First of all, the courage of a common man.Xiang Yu can indeed be called a hero. He likes to take the lead, go to the battlefield in person, and shout angrily to make thousands of people tremble in fear.But he couldn't let go and appoint good generals. Only generals, without handsome men, could only be regarded as brave men.

Secondly, the kindness of women.Xiang Yu usually treats others with respect and kindness, and speaks in a gentle manner. If any of his soldiers are sick, Xiang Yu will definitely cry with sympathy and share his food with everyone.But when it was time to confer a title or title to someone who had made great achievements, Xiang Yu's stinginess came out. He played with the official seal in his hand until it was worn out, and was reluctant to give it to the person who deserved it.
